question: Priya died of burns three years after her marriage to Ramesh. Before her death, Ramesh and his parents kept demanding a car as dowry and beat her. What offences are these?
My husband and his parents demand a car as dowry, beat me regularly and threatened to throw me out of the house. What can I complain about?
Two years after her marriage, Sunita killed herself after her husband harassed her for months for more dowry. Which offences apply to the husband?
A man has been following a woman home from college every day and keeps messaging her even though she clearly told him to stop. Which offence is this?
A male colleague keeps making sexual remarks to a woman in the office and asked her for sexual favours in return for a promotion. What offence is this?
In a crowded market a man pulled off a woman's dupatta and tried to tear her clothes. Which section applies?
My neighbour secretly filmed me through the bathroom window while I was bathing. He is a man and I am a woman. What offence has he committed?
On a crowded bus a man deliberately groped a woman standing next to him. Which offence is this?
A man stood outside a girls' hostel, whistled and made obscene gestures at a girl walking in. What offence is this?
While a husband and wife were living apart under a court's separation order, the husband had sexual intercourse with his wife without her consent. Which offence applies?
Rahul promised to marry Anjali, had a sexual relationship with her for a year on that promise, and then refused to marry her. What offence has he committed?
A man abducted a woman from her village to force her to marry him against her will. Which offence is this?
Mahesh married a second wife while his first wife was still alive and they were not divorced. What offence is this?
During a fight a husband threw acid on his wife's face, causing permanent scars. Which offence applies?
My brother-in-law beats me because I did not bring money from my parents' house after my marriage. I am a woman. What offence is this?
A mother-in-law locked her daughter-in-law in a room for days and gave her little food, demanding that her family pay more dowry. Which offences apply?
My husband slapped me repeatedly during an argument and has done this many times since our marriage. What offences are these?
After we broke up, my ex-boyfriend sent my private photos to my relatives to insult me. I am a woman. Which IPC offence applies?
A husband kicked his pregnant wife in the stomach, and she lost the baby. Which offences apply?
A man took a fifteen-year-old girl away from her parents' house without their consent and kept her with him. Which offence is this?
My father-in-law touched me inappropriately when my husband was away, intending to insult my modesty. I am a woman. What offence is this?
My husband threatened to kill me if I complained to the police about his beatings. What offence is this?
A man held a fake marriage ceremony with a woman, making her believe she was lawfully married to him, and then left her. What offence is this?
After my marriage, my husband and in-laws took my jewellery given by my parents and refuse to return it. I am a woman. What offence is this?
A man on a motorbike snatched a gold chain from a woman's neck on the road. Which offence is this?
A woman broke into her neighbour's shed at night and stole his bicycle. Which offence is this and what is the punishment?
A shopkeeper sold fake gold bangles to an old woman, telling her they were real gold. He is a man. What offence is this?
A man driving very fast on a busy road hit and killed a girl who was crossing at a zebra crossing. Which section applies?
During a quarrel about parking, a woman slapped her neighbour. He was not seriously hurt. What offence is this?
Ravi broke into his aunt's house while she was away and stole the cash kept in her cupboard. What offences are these?
An accountant took money from her employer's account for her own use over several months. She is a woman. What offence is this?
A man threatened his brother with a knife to make him hand over the property papers. Which offences apply?
A girl's uncle forged her signature on a land sale deed to sell her land. What offence is this?
A man entered a woman's farm without permission and destroyed her standing crops. What offences are these?
A woman hit a man with an iron rod during a fight and broke his arm. Which offence is this?
A son pushed his father during an argument; the father fell and broke his leg. What offence is this?
Vijay sold the same plot of land to two different buyers and took money from both. What offence is this?
A man found a woman's mobile phone on the bus and kept it for himself instead of returning it. What offence is this?
A woman set fire to her rival's car parked outside his house at night. Which offence is this?
A man gave his sister sweets mixed with poison intending to kill her; she was taken to hospital and survived. What offence is this?
